column1: # Interval formats expected by ICU4J 73 DateIntervalFormat, Gregorian, UTC.
# Columns: locale, fields (date, month, month_and_day, year_and_month) or
# time, format (a standard format, or the time skeleton), from, to, expected.
# ICU 73 ships CLDR 43 data. 14 generated rows are left out
# because later CLDR releases changed the locale data they use (de yM and M
# are "M/y" and de h inherits "h a" by CLDR 48; fr H inherits "HH" in
# CLDR 49); the test checks the de cases against CLDR 48 separately.
